+++ b/test_slab.c

+unsigned long x = KMALLOC_MAX_SIZE;

diff --git a/fs/ntfs3/frecord.c b/fs/ntfs3/frecord.c
index 41c7ffad2790..e46c7fe72201 100644
--- a/fs/ntfs3/frecord.c
+++ b/fs/ntfs3/frecord.c
@@ -2001,6 +2001,9 @@ int ni_fiemap(struct ntfs_inode *ni, struct fiemap_extent_info *fieinfo,
 	/*
 	 * To avoid lock problems replace pointer to user memory by pointer to kernel memory.
 	 */
+	if (fieinfo->fi_extents_max * sizeof(struct fiemap_extent) > KMALLOC_MAX_SIZE)
+		fieinfo->fi_extents_max = KMALLOC_MAX_SIZE / sizeof(struct fiemap_extent);
+
 	fe_k = kmalloc_array(fieinfo->fi_extents_max,
 			     sizeof(struct fiemap_extent),
 			     GFP_NOFS | __GFP_ZERO);
